decisions.reason: The award gives an early positive signal, and the yogurt is close to the core line, so keeping this option open costs little while its value appears to be materializing.
The cheese was just launched with home-page promotion, and its uncertainty is unresolved after one year, so the cheap option should stay open until sales data reveal its value.
This semi-hard cheese sits close to the established offer with low marginal holding cost, and there is no evidence yet against its value.
A niche flavored cheese in a crowded new cheese range carries some risk of pruning, but one year gives too little information to justify abandonment.
This soft cheese rounds out the new range and was actively promoted, so it is worth keeping while consumer response is still uncertain.
The washed-rind cheese is a more specialized product with higher handling costs and an uncertain organic retail demand, yet it is too early to abandon it without negative evidence.
